The members of Swamy family have built a replica of Tirupati Balaji temple in a small village, which is very far away from the actual temple. The head of the Swamy family ‘Amma’ is waiting patiently to get a chance of having Tirupati Balaji’s Darshan but at a very crucial moment Teja discovers that the idol of god is stolen by someone!
